recipe_name: One Pot Peri Peri Chicken & Rice
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Prepare the pepper and garlic. Brown chicken and pepper briefly with peri-peri seasoning and butter. Stir in garlic and tomato puree, then dry rice, stock and about 350 ml water. Cover and simmer gently for approximately 12–15 minutes, stirring once; check chicken is fully cooked and rice tender. Rest covered for 5 minutes. Warm drained sweetcorn with butter and serve over the rice with yoghurt. Use the quantities in recipe_ingredients.csv; water for cooking is not a purchased ingredient.
ingredient_notes: 0.5 cube chicken stock mix; 130 g long grain rice; 250 g chicken breast; 1 each red pepper; 30 g tomato puree/paste; 160 g sweetcorn; 10 g peri peri seasoning; 6 g garlic; 100 g natural yogurt; 20 g butter

cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure about 6 g red chilli (roughly one chilli) and 40 ml hoisin sauce, 2 garlic cloves. Cook brown rice according to its packet. Slice chicken and vegetables. Stir-fry chicken in the oil until cooked through, then add ginger, garlic and chilli. Add pak choi and kale and cook until tender. Mix hoisin, soy sauce, rice vinegar and cornflour with a little cold water; add and simmer until thickened. Serve with rice. Use the quantities in recipe_ingredients.csv; water for cooking is not a purchased ingredient.

Soften onion and garlic in a deep pan; stir in smoked paprika, coriander, cayenne and oregano. Add arborio rice, stock and water gradually, simmering and stirring until rice is tender. Fold in chicken, tomatoes and spinach and cook until hot and spinach has wilted. Season and serve. Use the quantities in recipe_ingredients.csv; water for cooking is not a purchased ingredient.

Stir-fry chicken in sesame oil until cooked through; add garlic, carrots, mangetout and spring onions. Mix BBQ sauce, hoisin, soy and five spice with a little water; add and heat through. Serve with rice. Use the quantities in recipe_ingredients.csv; water for cooking is not a purchased ingredient.

cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Cut sweet potato into wedges, toss with half the oil and roast at 200C fan until tender, about 25-35 minutes. Prepare couscous; combine with vegetables and lemon, top with halloumi. Use the quantities in recipe_ingredients.csv; water for cooking is not a purchased ingredient.

ingredient_notes: 250 g beef mince; 1 each aubergine; 120 g bulgur; 1 each brown onion; 250 g chopped tomatoes; 6 g garlic; 2 g cumin; 15 ml olive oil

Add drained chickpeas and spinach, cook until orzo is done. Finish with lemon and crumbled feta. Use the quantities in recipe_ingredients.csv; water for cooking is not a purchased ingredient.

Fry chicken until cooked; serve with shredded vegetables and lime. Use the quantities in recipe_ingredients.csv; water for cooking is not a purchased ingredient.

recipe_name: Indian red lentil dal with roast cauliflower
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Roast cauliflower with oil and cumin at 210C for 25 minutes. Simmer lentils with onion, garlic, tomatoes, turmeric and 450ml water until soft, 20-25 minutes. Serve with cooked rice. Use the quantities in recipe_ingredients.csv; water for cooking is not a purchased ingredient.
ingredient_notes: 180 g red lentils; 140 g basmati rice; 650 g cauliflower; 1 each brown onion; 400 g chopped tomatoes; 2.5 g ground turmeric; 2 g cumin; 6 g garlic; 15 ml oil

cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Slice the onion, trim green beans, grate garlic and cube halloumi. Cook 150 g basmati rice in 300 ml water: bring to a boil, cover on low for 10 minutes, then rest covered off heat for 10 minutes. Fry green beans for 3-4 minutes until beginning to soften and set aside. Fry halloumi until golden on all sides, about 4-5 minutes, then remove. Soften onion in the same pan for 5 minutes; add garlic, curry powder and tomato puree and stir for 1 minute. Add passata and 100 ml water; simmer 5 minutes. Return beans and halloumi, add most of the mango chutney and simmer 5-6 minutes. Mix remaining chutney into yoghurt and serve with curry and rice.

Prepare 30 g spring onions (about 2 spring onions). Heat oven to 180 C. Thinly slice onion, dice green pepper and halloumi, drain sweetcorn and slice spring onion. Heat a large frying pan with a splash of water and stir-fry pepper and sweetcorn for 4-5 minutes until softened and lightly coloured. Add onion and cook for 3-4 minutes more. Transfer the vegetables directly to the warmed tortillas; fry halloumi in the same pan for 5-6 minutes, turning until golden. Add the halloumi, spread mayonnaise over each taco and dot the chipotle paste across it, then scatter over spring onion. No sauce bowl is needed.
ingredient_notes: Method simplified to remove an unnecessary chipotle-mayonnaise mixing bowl; not kitchen-tested.

recipe_name: Halloumi Burger with Chickpea Mango Salad
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 0.5 lettuce. Halve burger buns and cut halloumi into thick slices. Toast buns cut-side down in a hot dry pan for about 1 minute and set aside. Fry halloumi for 2 minutes per side until golden. Separate lettuce leaves, reserving four for the burgers; shred the rest. Slice half the tomatoes for burgers and dice the remainder. Chop mint, zest and juice lime, and drain chickpeas. Mix yoghurt with mint and lime zest; spread a little onto buns. Toss remaining yoghurt with chickpeas, shredded lettuce, diced tomato, lime juice and half the mango chutney. Coat warm halloumi in remaining chutney. Assemble buns with reserved lettuce, tomato slices and halloumi; serve chickpea salad alongside.

For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Heat oven to 130 C to keep cooked gnocchi warm if needed. Grate garlic and slice mushrooms. Heat vegetable oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat; fry gnocchi for 8-10 minutes, turning until golden and crisp, then transfer to a warm plate. Add mushrooms to the pan and fry for 6-8 minutes until browned. Lower heat and stir in garlic for 1 minute. Add creme fraiche and about 150 ml water; stir and simmer for 1-2 minutes. Add spinach by handfuls and cook 2-3 minutes until wilted. Return gnocchi briefly to coat in sauce, then serve topped with grated hard cheese.

For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Boil orzo in salted water for about 10 minutes or according to packet instructions, then drain, reserving a little cooking water. Meanwhile fry diced chorizo in a dry large frying pan over medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes until coloured. Add grated garlic, smoked paprika and tomato puree and stir for 1 minute. Stir in creme fraiche and 150 ml water and simmer gently for 3-4 minutes. Add peas and cook until piping hot, about 2-3 minutes. Stir in grated hard cheese and cooked orzo, adding reserved cooking water if too thick. Divide between bowls.

For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Thinly slice leek, grate garlic, trim asparagus and chop parsley. Dissolve vegetable stock cube in 750 ml hot water and keep warm. Soften leek in a wide pan with a little water for 5-6 minutes; add garlic and cook for 1 minute. Stir in arborio rice for 1 minute. Add stock a ladle at a time, stirring and allowing each addition to absorb; continue for 20-25 minutes until rice is creamy and tender. Halfway through, pan-fry asparagus for 2 minutes, add a splash of water, cover and steam 3-5 minutes; remove. Cook prawns in the pan for 4-5 minutes until pink, opaque and cooked through; squeeze over lemon. Stir butter, grated hard cheese and most of the parsley into risotto. Top with prawns, asparagus and remaining parsley; serve with lemon wedges.

For two servings, measure 3 garlic cloves. Heat oven to 200 C. Grate garlic and stir it into a saucepan with rice and 300 ml water; bring to boil, cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes, then rest covered off heat for 10 minutes. Put salmon on a lined baking tray and roast for 10-15 minutes until opaque in the centre. Halve baby corn lengthways and cut broccoli into small florets. Stir-fry broccoli and corn in a non-stick pan for 2-3 minutes; add a splash of water, cover and steam for another 3-5 minutes until tender. Toss vegetables with half the sesame oil and half the sesame seeds and set aside. Warm teriyaki sauce and remaining sesame oil in the pan for 1-2 minutes, then carefully turn cooked salmon in the glaze. Serve on fluffed garlic rice with vegetables and remaining sesame seeds.

recipe_name: Thai Pork and Mangetout Rice Bowls
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves and about 6 g red chilli. Add rice and 300 ml water to a lidded saucepan; bring to boil, cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes, then rest covered off heat for 10 minutes. Chop onion and chilli, grate garlic and halve mangetout. Stir-fry mangetout in a hot non-stick pan for 2-3 minutes until tender; transfer to a plate. Add pork mince to the pan and brown for 5-6 minutes, breaking it up until fully cooked; drain excess fat. Add onion, garlic and chilli and cook for 2-3 minutes until fragrant. Return mangetout, add soy sauce and brown sugar directly to the wok and toss until the sugar dissolves and everything is piping hot, loosening with water if needed. Fluff rice and serve topped with pork stir-fry.

recipe_name: Coconut Lentil and Spinach Curry with Naan
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Slice onion, grate garlic, dice tomatoes, drain and rinse lentils, and zest and halve lime. Soften onion in a saucepan over medium heat with a splash of water for 5-6 minutes. Stir in garam masala, garlic and lime zest for 1 minute. Add coconut milk, drained lentils, half a vegetable stock cube and about 150 ml water; bring to boil, then simmer 6-8 minutes. Add diced tomatoes and spinach and cook 1-2 minutes until spinach wilts. Warm naan in a toaster or oven for 2-3 minutes. Stir mango chutney and lime juice into curry, adjust thickness with water and serve with warm naan.

recipe_name: Turkey and Feta Burgers with Chips
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 0.5 lettuce. Heat oven to 200 C. Cut potatoes into thin chips, toss with vegetable oil and spread on a baking tray; roast for 25-30 minutes, turning halfway, until golden. Crumble feta into turkey mince and mix thoroughly; divide into two patties. Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and cook patties for about 5-7 minutes per side until completely cooked through and the centre reaches 74 C. Rest for 2 minutes. Halve and toast burger buns cut-side down in the pan for about 1 minute. Slice tomatoes and shred lettuce. Fill buns with turkey-feta patties, lettuce and tomato, and serve with chips.

recipe_name: Cheesy Beef Tacos with Tomato Salsa
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 0.5 lettuce. Heat oven to 220 C (200 C fan). Cut potatoes into wedges and spread on a lined tray; roast for 30-35 minutes, turning halfway. Dice tomatoes and toss with lime juice to make salsa; shred lettuce. Heat a large non-stick frying pan and brown beef mince for 5-7 minutes, breaking it up until cooked through. Mix yoghurt, remaining mint and lemon; serve together.
ingredient_notes: Original household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: Fry sliced chorizo and pepper for 5 minutes. Add smoked paprika, chickpeas and chopped tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes. Make four wells, crack in eggs, cover and cook 5-8 minutes until whites set. Toast ciabatta and serve with the shakshuka.
ingredient_notes: Original household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

recipe_name: Ginger Soy Salmon with Sesame Broccoli
cooking_instructions: Heat oven to 200 C fan. Cook rice according to packet directions. Mix soy, grated ginger and honey. Roast broccoli for 10 minutes, then add salmon brushed with sauce and roast 12-15 minutes until cooked. Sprinkle sesame over broccoli and serve with rice and remaining sauce heated through.
ingredient_notes: Original household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: Boil potatoes until tender and mash with butter. Heat oven to 200 C fan. Fry chopped onion, carrot and mushrooms for 8 minutes; stir in tomato puree, drained lentils, half a stock cube and water. Simmer until thick. Transfer to a dish, spread mash on top and bake 20 minutes until golden.
ingredient_notes: Original household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: Mix turkey mince with breadcrumbs and form small meatballs. Brown in a pan for 6 minutes. Add orzo, half a chicken stock cube and enough water to cover; simmer 12-15 minutes, stirring and adding water as needed, until orzo and turkey are cooked. Fold in spinach, lemon zest and juice and cheese.
ingredient_notes: Original household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

recipe_name: Halloumi Courgette Fritters with Tomato Salad
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 1.5 courgettes. Grate courgette and squeeze out excess liquid. Grate halloumi and mix with courgette, egg and flour. Shape small fritters and pan-fry 3-4 minutes each side until golden and cooked. Chop tomatoes with mint and lemon. Serve fritters with tomato salad and yoghurt.
ingredient_notes: Original household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: Heat oven to 200 C fan. Fry sliced leek for 5 minutes and diced chicken for 6 minutes. Stir in mustard, creme fraiche and peas; simmer until chicken is cooked through. Spoon into a pie dish, cover with pastry, brush with beaten egg and bake 20-25 minutes until puffed and golden.
ingredient_notes: Original household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: Heat oven to 200 C fan. Toss cauliflower and drained chickpeas with cumin and paprika; roast for 25 minutes until golden. Chop cucumber and mix with yoghurt and lemon. Warm pittas briefly, fill with roasted vegetables and top with cucumber yoghurt.
ingredient_notes: Original household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

recipe_name: Beef Black Bean Pepper Stir Fry
cooking_instructions: Prepare 30 g spring onions (about 2 spring onions). Cook noodles according to packet directions. Stir-fry beef strips over high heat for 3-4 minutes until browned and remove. Stir-fry sliced peppers for 4 minutes, add black bean sauce, soy and a splash of water. Return beef and cook until done; toss with noodles and spring onions.
ingredient_notes: Original household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: Heat oven to 200 C fan. Simmer passata and halved cherry tomatoes for 5 minutes; wilt in spinach and stir through pesto. Boil gnocchi until they float, drain and mix with sauce. Transfer to a dish, tear mozzarella over and bake 12-15 minutes until bubbling.
ingredient_notes: Original household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: Brown chicken thighs in a covered pan for 5 minutes. Add chopped carrot, cumin, cinnamon, apricots, half a stock cube and water. Cover and simmer 20-25 minutes until chicken is fully cooked and sauce reduced. Prepare couscous with boiling water as directed and serve chicken over it with almonds.
ingredient_notes: Original household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: Prepare 30 g spring onions (about 2 spring onions). For two servings, measure 3 garlic cloves. Cook rice according to packet directions. Slice cucumber and spring onions and toss cucumber with half the lime juice. Brown pork mince in a hot pan for 6-8 minutes, breaking it apart. Add chopped garlic, brown sugar, fish sauce and a splash of water; simmer 3-4 minutes until sticky and pork is cooked. Spoon over rice and finish with cucumber, spring onions and remaining lime.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

recipe_name: Baked Feta Tomato Butter Bean Skillet
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 3 garlic cloves. Heat oven to 200 C fan. Put tomatoes, drained butter beans and garlic in a baking dish with oregano and olive oil. Place feta in the centre and roast for 20-25 minutes until tomatoes burst. Stir in spinach and return to oven for 3 minutes to wilt. Mash some tomatoes into the cheese to make a sauce. Toast ciabatta and serve alongside.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: Prepare 30 g spring onions (about 2 spring onions). Heat oven to 200 C fan. Coat diced chicken thigh and sliced pepper with jerk seasoning and roast 20-25 minutes until chicken is fully cooked. Cook basmati rice according to packet directions. Dice pineapple and stir through hot rice with lime juice and sliced spring onions. Serve roasted chicken and peppers over pineapple rice.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 3 garlic cloves. Finely chop onion and carrot and soften in a pan for 6 minutes. Add beef mince and brown thoroughly. Stir in garlic, oregano and passata and simmer 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cook the polenta cornmeal with water according to its packet directions until thick and tender, then stir in grated hard cheese. Serve the ragu over the polenta.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: Prepare 30 g spring onions (about 2 spring onions). Slice mushrooms and pak choi. Stir-fry mushrooms in half the butter for 6-8 minutes until browned; add pak choi and cook 3 minutes. Mix miso and soy with a splash of warm water. Loosen udon noodles according to packet directions, add to the pan with sauce and remaining butter, and toss 2-3 minutes until hot. Top with spring onions and sesame.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 1 courgette. Heat oven to 200 C fan. Coat salmon with harissa and roast for 12-15 minutes until cooked. Dice courgette and pan-fry for 6 minutes until golden. Prepare couscous with boiling water according to packet directions. Fold in courgette, orange segments and chopped mint. Serve with salmon and a spoonful of yoghurt.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 4 sausages, 3 garlic cloves. Brown sausages in a deep pan for 8 minutes, turning, then remove. Soften chopped onion for 5 minutes, add garlic and paprika, then stir in tomatoes and drained beans. Return sausages and simmer covered for 12-15 minutes until cooked through. Stir in kale and simmer 4 minutes. Toast ciabatta and serve with the stew.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

recipe_name: Paneer Pea Makhani with Jeera Rice
cooking_instructions: Cook basmati rice with half the ground cumin according to packet directions. Cube paneer and fry in half the butter until golden, about 5 minutes; remove. Warm remaining butter with garam masala and remaining cumin for 30 seconds, add passata and simmer 8 minutes. Stir in peas and cream and simmer 4 minutes, then return paneer to heat through. Serve with rice.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: Fry sliced chorizo and pepper in a deep pan for 5 minutes. Stir in paprika and dry rice for 1 minute. Add dissolved stock cube and enough hot water to cook rice; simmer 15-18 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add peas and prawns for the final 4-5 minutes until prawns are opaque and rice is tender. Squeeze over lemon and serve.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

recipe_name: Roast Pumpkin and Goat Cheese Tart
cooking_instructions: Heat oven to 200 C fan. Roast small squash cubes and sliced red onion for 20 minutes until soft. Lay pastry on a lined tray, score a 2 cm border and prick the centre. Scatter roast vegetables, torn sage and goat cheese over the centre; bake 18-22 minutes until pastry is golden. Drizzle honey over and serve with rocket.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

recipe_name: Lemon Garlic Chicken with Pearl Couscous
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 3 garlic cloves. Slice chicken into strips and brown in oil for 5 minutes. Add garlic and halved tomatoes and cook 2 minutes. Stir in giant couscous, half a dissolved stock cube and enough water to cover; simmer 10-12 minutes, stirring, until couscous and chicken are cooked. Fold in spinach to wilt, then finish with lemon zest and juice.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

recipe_name: Crispy Chickpea and Avocado Buddha Bowls
cooking_instructions: Heat oven to 200 C fan. Dry drained chickpeas and toss with cumin; roast with carrot batons for 20-25 minutes until golden. Prepare bulgur according to packet directions. Mix yoghurt with lemon juice and a little water to make dressing. Divide bulgur, chickpeas, carrots and sliced avocado between bowls; drizzle dressing and sprinkle pumpkin seeds.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 3 garlic cloves. Heat oven to 200 C fan. Halve courgettes lengthways, scoop out centres and finely chop the flesh. Brown turkey mince in a pan for 6 minutes, add chopped courgette, garlic, oregano and spinach, and cook until mince is fully cooked. Pour passata into a baking dish, fill courgette halves with turkey mixture, crumble feta over and bake 20-25 minutes until tender.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

recipe_name: Tamarind Glazed Cod with Coconut Rice
cooking_instructions: Cook jasmine rice with coconut milk and enough water according to packet directions. Steam green beans for 5-7 minutes until tender. Mix tamarind, honey, soy and lime juice. Pan-fry cod for 3-5 minutes each side until opaque and flaky; add glaze for the final minute and turn fish to coat. Serve with coconut rice and beans.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: Heat oven to 200 C fan. Slice aubergines and roast for 20 minutes until soft. Soften chopped onion for 5 minutes, add paprika, cinnamon, tomatoes and drained lentils and simmer 10 minutes. Layer aubergine and lentil sauce in a dish, spread ricotta on top and sprinkle hard cheese. Bake 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

recipe_name: Chipotle Chicken and Corn Enchilada Bake
cooking_instructions: Heat oven to 200 C fan. Dice chicken and fry with chopped red onion for 7-9 minutes until fully cooked. Stir in chipotle, sweetcorn and half the passata. Divide filling among tortillas, roll and place seam-side down in a dish. Spoon remaining passata over, top with cheddar and bake 15 minutes until bubbling. Serve with yoghurt.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

recipe_name: Herby Mushroom and Goat Cheese Galette
cooking_instructions: Heat oven to 200 C fan. Fry sliced mushrooms and onion in oil for 8-10 minutes until their moisture evaporates; add chopped thyme. Lay pastry on a lined tray, spoon cooled mushroom mixture into the centre leaving a border, and crumble goat cheese over. Fold pastry edges inward and bake 22-25 minutes until golden. Serve with rocket.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 3 garlic cloves. Cut pork into cubes and toss with lemon zest, oregano and minced garlic; leave 10 minutes. Thread onto skewers or spread on a grill tray. Grill under medium-high heat for 10-15 minutes, turning, until cooked through. Chop cucumber and mix with yoghurt and lemon juice. Warm pittas and fill with pork, chopped tomatoes and cucumber yoghurt.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: Bruise lemongrass and slice ginger. Simmer in coconut milk with 350 ml water for 8 minutes. Add chopped pak choi and rice noodles; simmer according to noodle packet directions. Add prawns for the final 3-5 minutes until pink and opaque. Remove lemongrass, season with fish sauce and lime and serve immediately.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person household adaptation; not kitchen-tested.

cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 3 garlic cloves. Heat oven to 190 C fan. Wilt spinach in a pan with garlic, cool and squeeze dry; chop and mix with ricotta and oregano. Boil the lasagne sheets for 4-5 minutes until flexible but not fully tender, then drain and keep them separate. Spread the filling over the sheets and roll them up. Put some passata in a baking dish, arrange the rolls seam-side down and cover with the remaining passata and a splash of water. Top with mozzarella, cover with foil and bake 25 minutes; uncover and bake for 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the cheese is golden.
ingredient_notes: Original two-person adaptation; changed to Tesco-stocked lasagne sheets because dry cannelloni tubes were unavailable

cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 3 garlic cloves. Boil potato wedges for 3 minutes and drain. Mix oil, zaatar, sumac, paprika, crushed garlic and lemon juice. Coat the chicken, potatoes, onion wedges, olives and lemon slices in the mixture. Spread on a tray with chicken on top and roast at 180 C fan for 35-40 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked and potatoes are golden. Finish with parsley and yoghurt.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

recipe_name: Pork and Vegetable Sweet Chilli Noodles
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 3 garlic cloves. Fry pork mince in sesame oil over high heat for about 8 minutes until browned. Meanwhile soften noodles according to the packet. Add ginger, garlic, sliced pepper, carrot and mangetout to pork and stir-fry 3-4 minutes. Blend cornflour with soy, sweet chilli sauce and a little water; add to pan with drained noodles. Toss over heat until sauce thickens and pork is fully cooked.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

cooking_instructions: Prepare 30 g spring onions (about 2 spring onions). For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Heat oven to 160 C fan. Whisk soy, vinegar, ginger, honey and garlic; pour half over salmon in a lined baking dish. Bake 15 minutes or until salmon is cooked. Cook noodles to packet directions and drain. Toast sesame seeds in a dry pan for 1 minute. Toss noodles with remaining sauce and cooking juices; serve salmon on top with spring onions and sesame.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Cook basmati rice following packet directions. Soften sliced onion in olive oil for 10 minutes. Add garlic and spices, stir 1-2 minutes, then add tinned tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes. Pour in coconut milk and simmer 10-15 minutes until thickened. Add drained chickpeas and fresh tomato wedges, warm through and finish with coriander. Serve with rice.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

cooking_instructions: Cook rice according to packet directions. Cut aubergine into wedges and brown in batches in a little oil, 2-3 minutes per side; set aside. Soften sliced onion, add chilli and spices, then stir in coconut milk, chopped tomatoes and water. Simmer 25 minutes to reduce. Return aubergine with drained chickpeas and simmer another 5 minutes until tender. Serve over rice.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

recipe_name: Vegetable Jalfrezi with Squash and Cauliflower
cooking_instructions: Cook sliced onion gently in oil for 8-10 minutes, then mix in jalfrezi paste. Add cubed squash, cauliflower florets, half a stock cube, passata and water. Simmer 20 minutes. Add peppers and drained chickpeas and cook 15-20 minutes more until vegetables soften. Meanwhile cook rice. Swirl yoghurt and coriander into the curry off the heat and serve with rice.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Cook rice as directed. Soften chopped onion in oil for 4 minutes; stir in ginger, garlic, curry powder, garam masala, turmeric and chilli for 1-2 minutes. Add cubed paneer, drained chickpeas, coconut milk, spinach, half a stock cube and water. Bring to a simmer for about 20 minutes until thick. Stir in mango chutney and lemon juice and serve with rice.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

recipe_name: Salmon Thai Red Curry Noodle Soup
cooking_instructions: Bring water and a chicken stock cube to a boil in a saucepan; stir in red curry paste. Add rice noodles and simmer for about 8 minutes, adjusting for packet directions. Add sliced mushrooms and baby corn for 2 minutes. Add bite-size salmon pieces and gently simmer 3-5 minutes until cooked. Remove from heat, season with lime, soy and sugar, and scatter coriander over bowls.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

recipe_name: Turkey Meatballs in Fennel Tomato Sauce
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 3 garlic cloves. Combine turkey mince, breadcrumbs and half the crushed garlic, shape into meatballs and chill 10 minutes. Soften onion, diced carrot and remaining garlic in half the oil for 5-6 minutes. Add fennel seeds briefly, then tomatoes and puree; simmer 15 minutes. Fry meatballs in remaining oil for 8-10 minutes until fully cooked, then warm through in sauce. Boil spaghetti according to packet directions and serve together.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

cooking_instructions: Mix teriyaki sauce, five-spice and curry powder and coat thin pork strips in half the mixture for 15 minutes. Roast pork at 180 C fan for 15-20 minutes until cooked, then rest 5 minutes. Meanwhile cook noodles slightly short of packet timing and drain. Stir-fry carrot, pepper and mangetout in oil for 3-4 minutes. Add sliced cooked pork, prawns, noodles and remaining sauce; toss 2-3 minutes until prawns are fully heated and noodles hot.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

cooking_instructions: Heat oven to 200 C fan. Slice peppers and onion, cube halloumi and toss with balsamic vinegar, oregano, oil and garlic paste. Spread over a baking tray and roast for 25-30 minutes until coloured. Warm drained cooked lentils according to packet directions, combine with roasted vegetables and halloumi, and finish with torn basil.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

cooking_instructions: Peel and segment orange over a bowl, keeping its juice. Whisk mustard, honey, vinegar and oil into the juice to make dressing. Shave carrot into ribbons and coat with dressing. Pan-fry sliced halloumi in a little oil for a few minutes per side until golden. Toss spinach with carrot and dressing, top with orange segments and hot halloumi.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

cooking_instructions: Boil halved potatoes for 15-20 minutes until tender, adding peas during the final 2 minutes. Drain and return them to the warm saucepan. Add the lemon juice, olive oil and chopped mint directly to the pan and toss. Sear thick halloumi slices in a hot non-stick frying pan until golden on both sides. Fold the rocket through the potatoes and peas, divide between plates and top with the halloumi.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; method simplified to dress the potatoes in their cooking pan; not kitchen-tested.

recipe_name: Turkey Korma Meatballs with Sugar Snaps
cooking_instructions: Cook rice according to packet directions. Mix turkey mince with a spoon of korma paste, shape into small meatballs and brown in oil for 5 minutes. In a saucepan soften chopped onion with remaining paste for 5 minutes. Add half a stock cube, water and coconut milk; bring to a simmer. Add meatballs and cook for 10-12 minutes until fully cooked. Add mangetout and halved tomatoes for the final 2 minutes, then scatter almonds over.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

recipe_name: Sticky Lime Pork and Mangetout Noodles
cooking_instructions: Mix honey with lime zest and juice; toss with thinly sliced pork and marinate 10 minutes. Cook noodles following packet directions. Thinly slice radishes, mangetout and carrot and combine with coriander. Lift pork from marinade and stir-fry in oil for 3-5 minutes until cooked. Boil reserved marinade in the pan for at least a minute. Serve pork and sauce over noodles with crisp vegetables.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

recipe_name: Sweet and Sour Pineapple Pork with Rice
cooking_instructions: Prepare 45 g spring onions (about 3 spring onions). Cook rice according to packet directions. Mix cornflour with pineapple juice or water, tomato puree, soy, sugar and vinegar to make sauce. Stir-fry thin pork strips in hot oil until browned, then remove. Stir-fry pepper for 2 minutes; add pineapple and most spring onions briefly. Add sauce and simmer until glossy. Return pork and cook until fully cooked, then serve over rice with remaining spring onion.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

cooking_instructions: Prepare 45 g spring onions (about 3 spring onions). For two servings, measure 3 garlic cloves. Cook rice noodles according to packet directions and drain. Heat oil in a pan, soften chopped garlic, ginger and chilli for 1-2 minutes. Add pork mince and fry for 5-7 minutes until browned and cooked through. Stir in black bean sauce and simmer 3-4 minutes. Toss with drained noodles and shredded spring onions, heating through before serving.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

recipe_name: Creamy Beef Mushroom Potato Crust Pie
cooking_instructions: Brown diced stewing beef in oil for about 10 minutes; set aside. Soften onion for 7 minutes, then mushrooms for 3 minutes. Add tomato puree and flour, cook 1 minute, then return beef with half a stock cube and water. Simmer gently covered for about 2 hours until beef is tender. Boil potatoes for 10 minutes, cool slightly and coarsely grate. Put filling in an oven dish, cover with grated potato and dot with butter. Bake at 170 C fan for 30 minutes until crisp.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

cooking_instructions: Prepare 45 g spring onions (about 3 spring onions). For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Heat oil in a large frying pan and stir-fry diced chicken for 4-5 minutes until browned. Add garlic and sliced pepper and cook 2 minutes more. Stir in spring onions, beansprouts, cooked or ready-to-wok noodles, oyster sauce and a splash of water. Toss for 2-3 minutes until noodles are hot and chicken is fully cooked.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

recipe_name: Air Fryer Sweet Potato Chickpea Curry
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Heat air fryer to 200 C. Toss cubed sweet potato with oil and air-fry 15 minutes until nearly tender. Add chopped onion and cook 5 minutes. Transfer to an air-fryer-safe tin, mix in ginger and garlic and cook 2 minutes. Stir in curry paste and drained chickpeas; cook another 4-5 minutes. Add tomatoes and cook 8-12 minutes until sauce thickens and potato is tender. Meanwhile cook rice; serve curry with coriander.
ingredient_notes: Adapted from linked published recipe; cooking method and sequence checked

cooking_instructions: Use 2 garlic cloves. Soften chopped onion in oil for 5 minutes. Add garlic, cubed aubergine, tomatoes, pesto, spices and 100ml water. Cover and simmer about 50 minutes until tender, adding water if needed. Top with sliced halloumi; bake at 200C fan for 15-20 minutes until golden. Add basil and serve with warmed pittas.
ingredient_notes: Source-grounded household adaptation; not kitchen-tested. One whole aubergine replaces 1.5 after scaling; added pitta makes a fuller dinner. Smoked paprika and cayenne replace paprika and chilli powder. Source: Halloumi bake (Serves 4); page retrieved 2026-10-22. Quantities below are the adapted two-person version. Ingredients: 200 g Halloumi; 1 each Aubergine; 1 each Red onion; 2 clove Garlic; 400 g Chopped Tomatoes; 20 g Red tomato pesto; 1 g Dried oregano; 1 g Smoked paprika; 1 g Cumin; 0.3 g Cayenne pepper; 5 g Basil; 15 ml Olive Oil; 2 each Pittas.

recipe_name: Pesto halloumi with chickpeas and kale
cooking_instructions: Toss drained chickpeas and tomatoes with oil and a squeeze of lemon. Roast at 200C fan for 20 minutes. Fold in chopped kale and pesto with a splash of water, top with halloumi and bake another 15 minutes. Finish with basil and remaining lemon to taste.
ingredient_notes: Source-grounded household adaptation; not kitchen-tested. Lemon replaces balsamic; halloumi increased from scaled 112.5g to 150g. Optional bread omitted. Source: Baked halloumi with chickpeas and greens (Serves 4); page retrieved 2026-10-22. Quantities below are the adapted two-person version. Ingredients: 150 g Halloumi; 240 g Chickpeas; 200 g Cherry tomatoes; 50 g Kale; 50 g Basil pesto; 15 ml Olive Oil; 1 each Lemon; 5 g Basil.

cooking_instructions: Slice peppers and fry in oil for 8 minutes. Add paprika and cumin. Brown sliced halloumi in a separate nonstick pan for 2-3 minutes per side. Mash avocado with lime juice. Warm tortillas and fill with peppers, cheese and avocado.
ingredient_notes: Source-grounded household adaptation; not kitchen-tested. Fresh avocado and lime replace guacamole dip; individual spices replace seasoning sachet. Rounded peppers and increased cheese for dinner portions. Source: Halloumi fajitas (Serves 4); page retrieved 2026-10-22. Quantities below are the adapted two-person version. Ingredients: 180 g Halloumi; 2 each Red pepper; 1 each Avocado; 4 each Tortillas; 2 g Smoked paprika; 2 g Cumin; 1 each Lime; 10 ml Olive Oil.

recipe_name: Halloumi pittas with sweet potato wedges
cooking_instructions: Prepare 30 g spring onions (about 2 spring onions). Roast sweet potato wedges with half the oil and paprika at 200C fan for 30 minutes. Mix diced cucumber, tomatoes, spring onion and parsley. Stir lemon juice into yogurt. Coat halloumi in curry powder and pan-fry in remaining oil until golden. Fill warm pittas with spinach, salad, halloumi and yogurt; serve wedges alongside.
ingredient_notes: Source-grounded household adaptation; not kitchen-tested. Spinach replaces lettuce; cucumber rounded to half; two pittas and 150g cheese for two dinners. Source: Halloumi pittas with sweet potato wedges (Serves 4); page retrieved 2026-10-22. Quantities below are the adapted two-person version. Ingredients: 150 g Halloumi; 300 g Sweet potato; 20 ml Olive Oil; 2 g Smoked paprika; 0.5 each Cucumber; 100 g Cherry tomatoes; 30 g Spring onion; 8 g Parsley; 60 g Natural yogurt; 1 each Lemon; 1 g Curry Powder; 2 each Pittas; 50 g Spinach.

recipe_name: Aubergine halloumi rolls with chickpea salad
cooking_instructions: Use 2 garlic cloves. Brush thin lengthways aubergine slices with oil and grill 4-5 minutes each side until flexible. Wrap halloumi pieces and basil in the slices; grill until cheese is hot and edges brown. Toss chickpeas with harissa, tomatoes and spinach. Thin tahini with lemon, crushed garlic and water; serve over the rolls and salad.
ingredient_notes: Source-grounded household adaptation; not kitchen-tested. Plain halloumi and spinach replace mint halloumi and mixed leaves; pulse and cheese portions increased. Source: Aubergine and halloumi rolls with chickpea salad (Serves 4); page retrieved 2026-10-22. Quantities below are the adapted two-person version. Ingredients: 1 each Aubergine; 150 g Halloumi; 180 g Chickpeas; 10 g Harissa paste; 15 ml Olive Oil; 5 g Basil; 60 g Spinach; 150 g Cherry tomatoes; 20 g Tahini; 1 each Lemon; 2 clove Garlic.

recipe_name: Halloumi with kale and bulgur tabbouleh
cooking_instructions: Cook bulgur following its packet and cool slightly. Massage finely chopped kale with lemon juice and oil. Add diced tomatoes, cucumber, finely chopped onion, herbs, dates, cumin and bulgur. Brown halloumi slices in a nonstick pan and serve on the salad.
ingredient_notes: Source-grounded household adaptation; not kitchen-tested. Dates replace raisins and red onion replaces shallot. Larger grain and cheese portions; cucumber rounded to half. Source: Raw kale tabbouleh with fried halloumi (Serves 4); page retrieved 2026-10-22. Quantities below are the adapted two-person version. Ingredients: 120 g Bulgur; 150 g Halloumi; 15 ml Olive Oil; 1 each Lemon; 1 each Red onion; 1 g Cumin; 70 g Kale; 150 g Tomatoes; 0.5 each Cucumber; 8 g Mint; 10 g Parsley; 30 g Chopped dates.

cooking_instructions: Chop cauliflower finely or pulse briefly in a processor. Fry it in half the oil with cumin for 8-10 minutes. Stir in drained lentils to heat through. Brown halloumi cubes in remaining oil. Combine with chopped parsley, tomatoes and lemon juice.
ingredient_notes: Source-grounded household adaptation; not kitchen-tested. Ground cumin replaces cumin seeds; weighed cauliflower and drained lentils standardise the source quantities. Source: Cauliflower rice and halloumi lentil salad (Serves 2); page retrieved 2026-10-22. Quantities below are the adapted two-person version. Ingredients: 400 g Cauliflower; 150 g Halloumi; 240 g Canned lentils (drained); 2 g Cumin; 20 ml Olive Oil; 15 g Parsley; 1 each Lemon; 150 g Cherry tomatoes.

recipe_name: Courgette and halloumi couscous with olives
cooking_instructions: Use 1 medium courgette, 1 red chilli, deseeded. Cover couscous and ground spices with boiling water according to its packet. Fry grated courgette in a little oil for 3 minutes. recipe_name: Sticky chilli paneer with mint salad
cooking_instructions: Use 1 red chilli, deseeded. Toss paneer cubes with cumin, curry powder, cayenne and cornflour. Fry in oil, turning until golden. Add vinegar and honey and toss briefly to glaze. Mix finely sliced onion, mint, chilli and cucumber. Serve with warm flatbreads.
ingredient_notes: Source-grounded household adaptation; not kitchen-tested. Source six snack portions converted to two dinners with flatbread and cucumber; cayenne replaces chilli flakes. Source: Chilli paneer bites with red onion and mint salad (Serves 6); page retrieved 2026-10-22. Quantities below are the adapted two-person version. Ingredients: 200 g Paneer; 2 g Cumin; 2 g Curry Powder; 0.3 g Cayenne pepper; 15 g Cornflour; 15 ml Oil; 12 ml Vinegar; 10 g Honey; 8 g Mint; 1 each Red onion; 1 each Red chilli; 2 each Flatbreads; 0.5 each Cucumber.
